chunks: Muhammad b. Ali Majiluwayh (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. Imran al-Ash'ari narrated to us. He said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from Muhammad b. Umar from Musa b. Ibrahim from Abi'l Hasan Musa b. Ja'far from his father from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said:

Umm Salama (may Allah be pleased with her) said to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family): May my father and mother be your ransom! A woman who had two husbands, and they all die and enter Paradise - which of the two will she be with? He (s) said: O Umm Salama! She will choose the one with more beautiful character and who was better to his family. O Umm Salama! Surely, beautiful character achieves the good of this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.الجنة: Paradise - the eternal abode of the righteous in the Hereafter
key_terms.حسن الخلق: Beautiful character (husn al-khuluq) - moral excellence that secures blessings in both worlds

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about a woman choosing between two husbands in Paradise?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through the Imams from Umm Salama, the Prophet Muhammad (s) answers a question about a woman with two deceased husbands in Paradise. He declares she will choose the one with better moral character and kindness to his family, emphasizing that good character (husn al-khuluq) encompasses the good of both worlds.
